exclusions.<BASE> and path separators in answers: the recorder's base folder is written back as <BASE> and every backslash as "/", so a replay on any platform compares its own base
exclusions.a skill whose owner is {kind: \"plugin\": the core's skill carries its plugin as one field (`plugin`); Node's two shapes of the same fact are not both an input to it
exclusions.withExtensionScope on kind \"mcp\" and o: the core refuses both before it writes (the settings call names MCP servers per project and checks the kind first), with the settings call's message, not withExtensionScope's

keptWhole: per case: its input and the answer (the normalized map, the roots, the verdict, the config)

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

syntheticInputs: the scope maps, cwds, skills and servers: the inputs of runtime-core/extension-scopes.test.mjs, written under <BASE>
